ownerDirective.speaker: project-owner
ownerDirective.exactText: remove all that you recommend and implement these 10 changes, then fan out a team of subagents to figure out the next move to build. I do not want to circle jerk and talk about building i want to build.
ownerDirective.interpretation: Proceed from planning into physical Combined Zones MVP construction. Exact scope-local releases may execute without a new per-package prose approval after the complete hard safety kernel passes.

mvpBoundary.included: All exact, independently reversible R07-R12 construction and commissioning packages inside the canonical Combined Zones Phase 1 physical domains.
mvpBoundary.exclusionRule: Deferred scopes remain sealed or reservation-only and cannot block MVP completion. A release manifest naming any excluded scope is not authorized by this record.

hardSafetyKernel.rule: Independent structural QA must bind an exact manifest and prove complete guarded states, forward/rollback inversion, target bijection, and package disjointness.
Every live invocation captures a fresh immutable source snapshot and passes exact source-state preflight in package order.
Every forward and rollback operation file passes a strict-noop parser dry-run before mutation.
REPL targets have zero block-entity intersections and a fresh same-moment live entity gate has zero blockers.
Forward execution uses strict-noop journals; a failed package triggers the exact inverse for the partial package and every committed package in reverse order.
A fresh immutable post snapshot must prove every reverse-order rollback guard, which simultaneously verifies exact intended post-state and reversibility.

currentPreparationBaseline.executionQualification: Preparation baseline only. A live --execute invocation must capture a new fresh source snapshot in that same invocation.

operationalControls.scopeLocalFailureRule: A failed safety check blocks only its exact release; it does not reinstate a project-wide hold.
